divergences_classified_against.source: the tree this corpus is committed with

input: variants.vcf: records from ClinVar GRCh37 (ID the ClinVar VariationID; every chromosome), 1000 Genomes phase 3 chromosome 21 (sequence and structural variants; rsID, ID-less, or the call set's SV ID), gnomAD v2.1.1 chromosome 21, gnomAD-SV v2.1 chromosome 21, and hand-built structural-variant records named synth_* (symbolic deletions, duplications, inversions, insertions and copy-number alleles, breakend pairs, multi-allelic and complex shapes); the manifest's records list carries every line
generator: scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116; scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py classify
